title: Army man linked to viral dog slaughter video faces demotion, charges
summary: MANILA, Philippines — A Philippine Army soldier has been relieved of his duties and faces possible demotion and formal charges over an alleged animal cruelty incident involving the slaughter of a dog…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A Philippine Army soldier has been relieved of his duties and faces possible demotion and formal charges over an alleged animal cruelty incident involving the slaughter of a dog that was recorded and posted on social media. Army spokesperson Col. Louie Dema-ala said the soldier assigned to the 1st Infantry Division had been relieved of his duties pending the resolution of an administrative case. “The minimum would be demotion from his rank,” Dema-ala said in a press briefing at Camp Aguinaldo, Quezon City. The soldier is currently at the division’s headquarters while awaiting the outcome of the investigation. […]... Keep on reading: Army man linked to viral dog slaughter video faces demotion, charges
